# Jeremiah 29 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-these [are] the-words-of the-letter which Jeremiah the-prophet sent from-Jerusalem to the-rest-of [the]-elders-of the-exile, and-to the-priests and-to the-prophets and-to all the-people whom Nebuchadnezzar had-taken-captive from-Jerusalem to-Babylon,

**2** And-YHWH declared concerning letter to the exiles through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**3** And-YHWH declared concerning letter to the exiles through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**4** And-YHWH declared concerning letter to the exiles through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**5** "Build houses and-dwell, and-plant gardens and-eat their-fruit.

**6** Take wives and-bear sons and-daughters, and-take for-your-sons wives and-your-daughters give to-husbands, and-let-them-bear sons and-daughters; and-multiply there and-do-not-diminish.

**7** And-seek the-peace-of the-city where I-have-exiled you, and-pray for-it to-YHWH, for in-its-peace you-will-have peace."

**8** And-YHWH declared concerning letter to the exiles through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**9** And-YHWH declared concerning letter to the exiles through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**10** "For thus says YHWH: 'When seventy years for-Babylon are-fulfilled, I-will-visit you and-establish toward-you My-good word, to-bring-you-back to this place.

**11** For I know the-plans which I am-planning for-you,' declares YHWH, 'plans-of peace and-not for-evil, to-give to-you a-future and-a-hope.

**12** And-YHWH declared concerning letter to the exiles through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**13** And-you-will-seek-Me and-find [Me], when you-search-for-Me with-all your-heart.

**14** And-I-will-be-found by-you,' declares YHWH, 'and-I-will-restore your-fortunes and-gather-you from-all the-nations and-from-all the-places where I-drove-you,' declares YHWH, 'and-I-will-bring-you-back to the-place from-which I-exiled-you.'"

**15** And-YHWH declared concerning letter to the exiles through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**16** And-YHWH declared concerning letter to the exiles through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**17** And-YHWH declared concerning letter to the exiles through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**18** And-YHWH declared concerning letter to the exiles through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**19** And-YHWH declared concerning letter to the exiles through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**20** And-YHWH declared concerning letter to the exiles through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**21** And-YHWH declared concerning letter to the exiles through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**22** And-YHWH declared concerning letter to the exiles through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**23** And-YHWH declared concerning letter to the exiles through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**24** And-YHWH declared concerning letter to the exiles through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**25** And-YHWH declared concerning letter to the exiles through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**26** And-YHWH declared concerning letter to the exiles through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**27** And-YHWH declared concerning letter to the exiles through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**28** And-YHWH declared concerning letter to the exiles through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**29** And-YHWH declared concerning letter to the exiles through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**30** And-YHWH declared concerning letter to the exiles through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**31** And-YHWH declared concerning letter to the exiles through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**32** And-YHWH declared concerning letter to the exiles through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **29:1**: Opening formula for the letter to the exiles oracle. Prophetic messenger formula with historical setting.

- **29:16**: Central imagery of planted community — integral to Jeremiah's prophetic discourse on judgment and restoration.

- **29:32**: Concluding declaration — ne'um YHWH ('declares YHWH'). The prophetic oracle is sealed by divine authority.

— EMET
